declared_cases.note: Serious = at least one section in the case carries a maximum sentence of 5+ years. Estimated 2 of 23 cases qualify - the affidavit's section tally includes one IPC 452 charge (house-trespass after preparation for hurt, max 7yr) and one IPC 435 charge (mischief by fire, max 7yr), each appearing once, distinct from the many repeating minor public-order sections (143/188/341/149/34/353/290/153A/505(2)/etc). Charges were framed in 2 of the 23 cases (both non-serious: 153A/504/505(2); 153/143/290/505(2)/149); zero convictions.
